official_definition: Dispersion: X (When Battles) When you use a Magic card that targets one opposing Spirit/Ultimate, change the number of targets to X.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dispersion] or [Dispersion: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dispersion]", "give [Dispersion]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
